normal: Do both zones complete B -> A -> C -> A -> Server?
full-control-loop: Do all seven software roles participate in the complete control loop?
packet-loss: Does a dropped control frame retry and execute once?
ack-loss: Does a lost receipt ACK retry without a second actuator execution?
duplicate-command: Does a duplicated logical command execute once?
delayed-result: Can an unknown execution outcome be resolved by a late result?
lost-result: Does missing CONTROL_RESULT remain explicitly UNKNOWN without blind reexecution?
reordered-messages: Is old telemetry retained for audit but excluded from fresh control?
sensor-fault: Does a broken B1 channel block C1 while the other zone continues?
gateway-failover: Does A2 take over and synchronize sensor/controller generation?
stale-generation: Does a command from a deposed epoch remain rejected?
server-offline: Does edge control continue and history replay after cloud recovery?
queue-replay: Do 250 queued messages replay without any new telemetry trigger?
policy-replay: Does an older policy leave current thresholds unchanged?
split-brain: Does a controller reject a non-owner at the same epoch?
expired-command: Does an expired command leave the actuator untouched?
